topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Sales loads. Some mutual funds charge a fee called a sales load, which compensates the investment professional for selling the mutual fund shares to you. Sales loads can be front-end in that they are paid at the time you make your investment, or back-end in that you pay the fee when you sell the mutual fund shares, usually within a specified timeframe.
question: Misconception: A mutual fund sales load is an ongoing fee charged regularly for as long as you hold the fund.
answer: A sales load is a transaction fee, not an ongoing fee. It compensates the investment professional for selling the fund shares and may be charged when you invest (front-end) or when you sell the shares (back-end, usually within a specified timeframe).
